#  14054 - Immunological Methods and Data Analysis Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **14054**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Immunological Methods and Data Analysis**  |  
|  Immunologische Methoden und Datenlanalyse   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty GW - Faculty of Health Sciences Brandenburg   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Rossol, Manuela 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After finishing the module, students are able to work out an immunological (or cell biological) method independently, to analyze and visualize data sets, and to prepare a short scientific presentation. In addition, they are able to give feedback.  |  
| Contents:  | Students are assigned a research question that involves a specific immunological (or cell biological) method. In the first phase, the students will familiarize themselves theoretically with the method and present the method in a 10-minute presentation + 10-min discussion. In the second phase, the students will be provided with data sets matching their assigned method and perform data analysis and visualization. The results will be presented by the student in a 10-minute presentation + 10-min discussion. In the third phase, the students will prepare a 10-minute scientific talk (+ 10-min discussion) about the assigned research question (background, methods, results). All three presentations will be accompanied by a practice giving feedback.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of basic cell biology is recommended  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Study project / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Project-dependent, will be announced in the first class meeting.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | The students will receive three grades throughout the semester:1. Method presentation (1/3)2. Data presentation (1/3)3. Scientific talk (1/3)  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | 5  |
